inside/maxInside/counter are written by 8 goroutines with no synchronization. go test -race fails here, and it is the ONLY race in the repo: the engine package is race-clean with this file removed, race-dirty with it restored. The gate omits -race, so it passes. The race also makes maxInside an unreliable witness for the invariant asserted. Measured 1/10 failures against the pre-fix lock, so the header comment is wrong: a 10%-power flaky detector, not a non-detector.

Fix verified: 0 lost rounds in ~2400 concurrent records (4/8/16-way); the same tree with only the unlink restored loses 3/400, all exit 0. SIGKILL leaves no stale lock (next acquire 0.03s); growth is one zero-byte 0o600 file per target. But L59 MkdirAll creates .tp/locks without EnsureTPGitignore, so 'git-ignored .tp/locks' is false when .tp/ was made by the lock path: after tp claim in a repo that never ran tp init, git add -A stages the lock. Now permanent, not transient.

The new test FAILS under go test -race: counter/inside/maxInside are mutated by 8 goroutines and flock gives the detector no happens-before edge, so `go test -race -run TestWithFileLock ./internal/engine/` reports a data race and fails the package. Gate and CI run `go test ./...` without -race, so nothing failed - the same shape as round 11's finding. Fix with atomics, not a mutex: a mutex round the body would force maxInside to 1 regardless of the lock.
